added.summary: The engine ships component documents in place of the TS builders, in packages/engine/src/ui/screens: card, confirm, pagination, data-list, key-values, table, tree, calendar, objective-tracker, star-rating, banner, subtitles and notifications, each with its props, actions and a default fixture (docs/ui.md §2). `og ui eject <name>` copies one into a game.

fixed.member: <dialog modal>, popover and -og-spotlight in a mounted document
fixed.summary: A container inside a modal dialog, a popover or a spotlight's callout now shows its content in a mounted (retained) document; before, its children were dropped from the first frame (a modal's footer of buttons showed empty), because they were named apart from the top-layer node they are built under.

breaking.change: `modal` is refused when bound (`modal={$x}`): a modal's content is built in the top layer, under `<id>/Panel`, so it is fixed when the document is written, as HTML chooses showModal() or show() per opening.
breaking.fix: Write `modal` as a literal; for a dialog that is sometimes modal, write two dialogs or put one in `{#if}`.
